It is context for cor:host, and no proof in the note uses it as a step. Rekey of sk-lef-assembly's 8b4f6b0857f1 @696c4b602.

ms-traces-1 @8b36733d7 (census 9cb80166d), tex l.336-338: "Then [f_jk,t_k] multiplies the first coordinate by mu_k(gamma_j)". The Prop PrintedCommutatorMultipliesFirstCoordinate is, for every finite group Q and x in Q, commutatorElement (fPerm Q x) (tPerm Q) = levelwise (fun _ => Equiv.mulLeft x) on Q x ZMod |Q|. Here tPerm adds 1 to the second coordinate and fPerm x multiplies the first coordinate of (y,i) from the left by x^i; m_k = |Q_k| and x = mu_k(gamma_j), the printed generality. It is proved by sk-lef-ultra's commutator_fPerm_tPerm (GroupTheory/LevelCommutatorWords, LANDED 174130833), and the endpoint is #audit_closed_axioms in Manuscript/SimpleKazhdanSofic/LEFLevelEmbedding (563dac8bc). "As in the embedding of B. H. Neumann and H. Neumann" credits the method and is not a step. Neither module is root-wired yet; ms-traces-1 GREEN 0914-090402-30789 lists both files at their origin bytes.
